verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but Google gaps and overdue work need closing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 40 leads at a cost of $38.94 per lead, and in the most recent week that cost dropped 37% while lead volume rose 17% — a real efficiency gain driven entirely by Meta, which delivered all 40 tracked leads on $588 in spend. Google Ads produced 12 conversions on $969 in spend but went dark for three days including October 25, leaving Meta to carry the full load; we are resolving the Google continuity issue this week. Separately, nine planned deliverables — including heating campaigns, LSA re-enablement, and the fall creative package — are overdue and are being prioritized for completion before the end of October. Once Google is running consistently and those campaigns are live, you should see lead volume and pipeline coverage increase heading into the heating season.
